description.narrative: Cabo Verde - Infrastructure Project - Roads and Bridges Activity: Roads and Bridges (the "Roads and Bridges Activity"): The Activity will focus on improving transportation networks on two islands, Santiago and Santo Antao. These improvements will link agricultural and fishing communities to the main traffic network and improve all-weather traffic access. To enable basic access and improved mobility on these two islands, MCC Funding will support the following: (i) Road rehabilitation on Santiago Island and (ii) Bridge construction and related works on Santo Antao Island
